## 简体中文

- 域名分流和 DNS 设置修改后直接保存到后端，避免切换页面后丢失新增规则集或编辑内容。
- 中国大陆域名规则集新增启用开关和直连／代理选择，支持代理节点切换，自定义规则优先。旧配置默认保持启用且直连；修改后重启核心生效。
- DNS 重写的新增和编辑统一使用带确认、取消按钮的弹框；新增时打开空表单，保存失败保留输入。
- 精简多个页面顶部多余的保存、刷新按钮；网关和隧道配置改为专用编辑弹框。
- 优化节点选择及域名分流相关文案。

## English

- Save domain routing and DNS settings directly to the backend so new rule sets and edits survive page navigation.
- Add an enable switch and direct/proxy routing for the built-in Mainland China domain set, with proxy node selection and custom rules taking priority. Existing configurations remain enabled and direct by default; restart the core to apply changes.
- Use the same confirmation dialog to add and edit DNS rewrites. New entries start with a blank form, and failed saves retain the input.
- Remove redundant page-level Save and Refresh actions, and move gateway and tunnel configuration into dedicated editing dialogs.
- Clarify node selection and domain routing labels.
